verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents connecting banks, credit cards, PayPal, Square and more to import transactions automatically, and records and matches invoice payments without manual entry. Dedicated PayPal, Square and Shopify connectors cover payments, and a community user mentions automatic categorization rules for imported transactions. Payroll is only shown as a native Payroll AI that runs payroll; nothing shows payroll activity posting to the ledger or third-party payroll systems connecting. Missing for 10: evidence that payroll postings flow into the ledger automatically, any connection to external payroll providers, independent corroboration of bank-feed reliability.
